heading.title: How It Works
heading.description: Go from a blank canvas to a production-ready, event-driven API in five mechanical steps. No complex infra hosting required.

design.title: Drag and Connect Nodes
design.subtitle: Design Phase
design.description: Select from over 100+ pre-built triggers, actions, and logical operators. Drag them onto the zero-lag canvas and route your data by connecting matching output-to-input ports.

validate.title: Configure Payloads
validate.subtitle: Validation Phase
validate.description: Click on any node to open its properties. Map incoming JSON fields, write custom mapping expressions with autocomplete support, and let our strict schema engine validate your connections.

deploy.title: Deploy and Run
deploy.subtitle: Production Phase
deploy.description: Hit Deploy to publish your workspace. Your workflow immediately compiles into a highly optimized, stateful execution pipeline running on global edge nodes.

monitor.title: Monitor Pipeline Health
monitor.subtitle: Telemetry Phase
monitor.description: Watch real-time pressure gauges and throughput metrics. Our built-in observability suite catches bottlenecks before they cause a system failure.

scale.title: Scale Infrastructure
scale.subtitle: Expansion Phase
scale.description: Allocate more compute to your boilers. The system automatically provisions additional edge workers to handle traffic spikes without breaking a sweat.
